classDiagram
    class UiMockupArtifact {
        string externalId
        string title
        string attachedToExternalId
        int viewportWidth
        int viewportHeight
        string screen
        string state
        string fidelity
        string acceptedSvg
        int acceptedRevision
        MockupStatus status
    }

    class UiMockupManifest {
        int schemaVersion
        string key
        string attachedToExternalId
        string viewport
        string screen
        string state
        string fidelity
    }

    class UiMockupDraft {
        string mockupId
        int baseRevision
        string workingSvg
        datetime updatedAt
    }

    class UiMockupEditOperation {
        string mockupId
        int sequence
        string kind
        string targetElementId
        string payloadJson
    }

    class UiMockupAnnotation {
        string id
        string mockupId
        string svgPath
        string optionalText
    }

    class UiMockupProposal {
        string mockupId
        int baseRevision
        string proposedSvg
        string proposedManifest
        datetime createdAt
    }

    class MockupPreview {
        string mockupId
        int sourceRevision
        string variant
        bytes png
    }

    class MockupStatus {
        accepted
        workingDraft
        pendingAgent
        proposed
    }

    class MockupSvgPolicy {
        stableElementIds
        allowedSvgElements
        noScript
        noExternalUrls
        separateAnnotationLayer
    }

    UiMockupArtifact "1" --> "1" UiMockupManifest : describes
    UiMockupArtifact "1" --> "0..1" UiMockupDraft : working copy
    UiMockupDraft "1" --> "0..*" UiMockupEditOperation : records
    UiMockupDraft "1" --> "0..*" UiMockupAnnotation : annotates
    UiMockupArtifact "1" --> "0..1" UiMockupProposal : candidate
    UiMockupArtifact --> MockupStatus
    UiMockupArtifact --> MockupSvgPolicy : validated by
    MockupPreview ..> UiMockupArtifact : derived from
